access_and_licensing.exceptions: Specially marked audiovisual, image, music, commissioned, or third-party works may require separate permission.
access_and_licensing.license: Taiwan Government Data Open License 1.0 with attribution
access_and_licensing.publication_review: Operator/legal review is required before republishing audio because the academy terms prohibit unauthorized commercial use and the government declaration excludes specially marked audiovisual works.

intentionally_excluded.general_support_materials: Undated proficiency standards and language-selection packages are supporting materials, not annual exam events.
intentionally_excluded.vocabulary_only_materials: Instructional lexicons and vocabulary audio are not examination questions, answers, or sample tests.

probe_policy.files_section_scope: Only current unretained URLs, source-only sample bundles, and alternate official question-audio packages are enumerated; retained exact primary files are summarized by listing hashes.

retained_state_recheck.earlier_capture_is_historical: Initial-capture findings above are preserved as dated evidence, not current provider-state facts.
retained_state_recheck.publication: Withheld: unresolved material/date identity and existing audiovisual/third-party redistribution limits remain. Public mirror backup creation stays prohibited.
retained_state_recheck.remaining_identity_issue: The advanced sample event still uses synthetic 2026 identity for undated material; the delisted intermediate family and historical source references require review.
retained_state_recheck.role_correction: Fifteen ZIP/RAR package references were reclassified as questions on 2026-10-07; all originals remain in the revision journal. ZIP suffix no longer implies listening audio.
